build_normalize_transform: build a Normalize transform to normalize image pixels using mean and std values
build_resize_transform: build a Resize transform to resize images, bounding boxes, and keypoints with optional aspect ratio
build_pad_transform: build a Pad transform to pad images to fixed size, divisor, or square shape
build_center_crop_transform: build a CenterCrop transform to crop the center of images with optional auto padding
build_test_time_aug: build a TestTimeAug transform to apply multiple scale and flip augmentations at test time
